# Egap.Pdf: guide for coding agents

Egap.Pdf reads, edits, renders, signs, redacts and saves PDF files, damaged and encrypted ones included: pages, outlines,
metadata, annotations, forms, attachments, layers, text and image extraction, drawing through an Egami canvas, PDF/A,
optimize, stamps, imposition, compare, OCR layers and print preflight. It is fully managed; images, fonts and drawing come
from Egami.

Namespaces: `Egap.Pdf`, with `Egap.Pdf.Ocr` for searchable scans, and `Egami` and `Egami.Pixels` for rendered pages.

## Egap's vocabulary

Egap has its own names. Use them, not names from other PDF, Word or Excel libraries: there is no `PdfReader`, `PdfWriter`,
`XWPFDocument`, `Range.Text` or `IWorkbook` in Egap.

- `PdfDocument` (namespace `Egap.Pdf`) is a PDF file: `PdfDocument.Open`, `PdfDocument.Create`, `PdfDocument.Merge`, then
  `Pages`, `Metadata`, `Outline`, `Form`, `Attachments`, `Signatures` and `Save`. It is `IDisposable` and keeps its file open
  until disposed.
- `Document` (namespace `Egap.Documents`) is a flow document: one model for DOCX, DOC, RTF, ODT, plain text, PDF, HTML,
  MHTML, EPUB and Markdown. `Document.Load` and `Save` pick the format; `DocumentBuilder` edits at a cursor. It is not
  disposable.
- `Workbook` and `Worksheet` (namespace `Egap.Spreadsheets`) are an Excel workbook and its sheets; `sheet["B2"]` is a
  `Cell`, `sheet.Range("A1:C9")` a `CellRange`, and `CellValue` a cell's value.
- `Presentation` (namespace `Egap.Presentations`) is a PowerPoint file: `Presentation.Load`, `Slides`, `SlideMasters` and
  `Save`; `slide.Shapes` holds its `SlideShape`s.
- Each format has its own class (`DocxFormat`, `RtfFormat`, `OdtFormat`, `TextFormat`, `HtmlFormat`, `EpubFormat`,
  `MarkdownFormat`) and members on `Document` that forward to it: `Document.LoadDocx`, `SaveAsDocx`, `ToHtml`,
  `SaveAsMarkdown`. `SaveAsPdf` and `PdfConvert` (namespace `Egap.Documents.Pdf`) write PDF.
- Options are objects with `init` properties, set in an object initializer and passed to the call: `PdfReadOptions`,
  `PdfSaveOptions`, `PdfRenderOptions`, `PdfExportOptions`, `PdfConvertOptions`, `LayoutOptions`, `WorkbookLoadOptions`.
- Damaged input is repaired and reported, not thrown: `pdf.Warnings` (`PdfWarning`), a `Load` overload with
  `out IReadOnlyList<ConversionWarning>`, and the list `Document.Save` returns. A `Strict` option throws instead.
- Sizes are PDF points (1/72 inch). `Length.Mm(15)`, `Length.Cm`, `Length.In` and `Length.Pt` (namespace `Egap.Pdf`) turn
  into points by themselves. Page indexes in code count from 0; `PdfPageRange.Parse("1-3,z")` takes page numbers from 1.
- Images, fonts and drawing come from Egami: a page renders to an Egami `Raster<Rgba8>` (namespaces `Egami` and
  `Egami.Pixels`), and draws onto any Egami.Drawing `Canvas`.
- Egap never opens a network connection by itself: the resolver, base folder or `HttpClient` you pass decides what a
  document may fetch.

## Entry points

- `PdfDocument.Open(path | stream | bytes, PdfReadOptions)`: a file to read and edit. `PdfReadOptions.Password` opens an
  encrypted one, `Strict` throws a `PdfException` instead of repairing, and the `Max*` limits bound hostile files.
- `PdfDocument.Create()` starts an empty document; `Pages.AddBlank`, `InsertBlank`, `Import`, `Move` and `RemoveAt` change
  pages. `PdfDocument.Merge(a, b)` and `ExtractPages(PdfPageRange.Parse("1-3,z"))` make new documents.
- `pdf.Save(path, PdfSaveOptions)`: incremental by default; `Mode = PdfSaveMode.Rewrite`, `Compression`, `Linearize`,
  `Deterministic` and `Encryption = PdfEncryption.Aes256(user, owner)` for a whole new file.
- `page.ExtractText()`, `page.GetImages()`, `pdf.FindText(...)`: text in reading order, placed images, matches with boxes.
- `page.Render(new PdfRenderOptions { Dpi = 150 })` gives a `Raster<Rgba8>`; `page.RenderTo(canvas)` draws on any Egami
  canvas; `pdf.RenderPagesToFiles("page-{page:00}.png", options)` writes them all.
- `new PdfCanvas(page)`: Egami.Drawing's canvas, written as PDF content over the page.
- `pdf.Form` (`TryGetField`, `AddTextField`, `AddCheckBox`, `Flatten`), `pdf.Metadata`, `pdf.Outline`, `pdf.Attachments`,
  `page.Annotations`.
- `pdf.RedactText`, `MarkRedactions`, `ApplyRedactions`, `ReplaceText` and `Sanitize`: real removal of content.
- `PdfAConverter.Convert(pdf, PdfAConformance.PdfA2u)`, `PdfInvoice.Embed` (Factur-X, ZUGFeRD), `PdfPreflight.Run`.
- `pdf.SignAsync(fieldName, PdfSignOptions, output)` and `signature.Verify(PdfVerifyOptions)`: PAdES B-B to B-LTA.
- `pdf.Optimize`, `pdf.Stamp(PdfStamp.Text(...))`, `PdfImpose.NUp`, `PdfCompare.Run`, `RemoveBlankPages`,
  `DeskewScannedPages`, and `PdfOcr.MakeSearchableAsync` with an Egami OCR engine.

## Samples

Open, edit and save:

```csharp
using Egap.Pdf;

using PdfDocument pdf = PdfDocument.Open("in.pdf");
Console.WriteLine(pdf.Pages[0].ExtractText());                   // lines in reading order

pdf.Metadata.Title = "Quarterly report";
pdf.Outline.Add("Summary", PdfDestination.ToPage(pdf.Pages[0]));
pdf.Save("out.pdf");                                             // incremental: the original bytes plus the changes
```

Pages, outline, annotations and forms:

```csharp
using Egap.Pdf;

using PdfDocument pdf = PdfDocument.Open("in.pdf", new PdfReadOptions { Password = "secret" });
foreach (PdfWarning warning in pdf.Warnings) Console.WriteLine(warning);

pdf.Pages.Move(0, pdf.Pages.Count - 1);                  // pages: insert, remove, move, labels
pdf.Metadata.Title = "Quarterly report";                 // Info and XMP kept in step
pdf.Outline.Add("Summary", PdfDestination.ToPage(pdf.Pages[0]));
pdf.Pages[0].Annotations.Add(new PdfHighlightAnnotation(PdfTextMarkupAnnotation.Quad(new PdfRectangle(72, 700, 300, 714))));

if (pdf.Form.TryGetField("customer.name", out PdfField field) && field is PdfTextField name)
{
    name.Value = "Ada Lovelace";                         // the widget is redrawn
}

pdf.Form.Flatten();                                      // fields drawn into the pages and removed
pdf.Save("out.pdf");                                     // incremental: the original bytes plus the changes
```

Render a page to PNG:

```csharp
using Egami;
using Egami.Pixels;
using Egap.Pdf;

using PdfDocument pdf = PdfDocument.Open("in.pdf");
using Raster<Rgba8> image = pdf.Pages[0].Render(new PdfRenderOptions { Dpi = 150 });
image.Save("page.png");
```

Redact a phrase for real:

```csharp
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Egap.Pdf;

using PdfDocument pdf = PdfDocument.Open("statement.pdf");
pdf.RedactText("Ola Nordmann", new PdfFindOptions { MatchCase = false });
pdf.RedactText(new Regex(@"\b\d{11}\b"));                 // Norwegian national identity numbers
pdf.Save("statement-redacted.pdf");                      // written whole, so nothing redacted survives
```

Convert to PDF/A:

```csharp
using Egap.Pdf;

using PdfDocument archive = PdfDocument.Open("report.pdf");
PdfAReport conversion = PdfAConverter.Convert(archive, PdfAConformance.PdfA2u);
if (conversion.Succeeded)
{
    archive.Save("archive.pdf", new PdfSaveOptions { Linearize = true });   // linearized for fast web view
}
```

Page numbers on every page but the cover:

```csharp
using Egap.Pdf;

using PdfDocument pdf = PdfDocument.Open("report.pdf");
pdf.Stamp(PdfStamp.Text("Page {page} of {total-pages}") with
{
    Anchor = StampAnchor.BottomCenter,
    Offset = new(0, Length.Mm(10)),
    PageRange = PdfPageRange.Parse("2-z"),              // no number on the cover
});
pdf.Save("report-numbered.pdf");
```

Sign with a PFX certificate:

```csharp
using System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates;
using Egap.Pdf;

using HttpClient http = new();
using PdfDocument pdf = PdfDocument.Open("in.pdf");
using X509Certificate2 certificate = X509CertificateLoader.LoadPkcs12FromFile("me.pfx", "password");
await using (FileStream signed = File.Create("signed.pdf"))
{
    await pdf.SignAsync("Signature1", new PdfSignOptions             // PAdES, incremental, written to a new stream
    {
        Signer = PdfSigner.FromCertificate(certificate),
        Level = PadesLevel.BaselineT,
        Timestamp = new PdfTimestampClient(new Uri("https://tsa.example.com"), http),  // Egap opens no connection itself
    }, signed);
}
```

## Common mistakes

- Forgetting `using` on a `PdfDocument`. It holds its file (or seekable stream) open until disposed, and a stream it reads
  must not change meanwhile. Documents from `Merge`, `ExtractPages`, `Create` and `PdfImpose` need disposing too.
- Mixing page numbers and indexes: `pdf.Pages[0]` and `PdfTextMatch.PageIndex` count from 0, while `PdfPageRange.Parse`
  and the `{page}` placeholder count from 1. `PdfPageRange.Resolve(count)` gives 0-based indexes.
- Mixing coordinate systems: `PdfRectangle(left, bottom, right, top)` is PDF user space, in points from the bottom left of
  the page; `PdfCanvas` draws in points from the top left as a viewer shows the page.
- Expecting a `PdfRedactAnnotation` to remove anything. Only `ApplyRedactions` (or `RedactText`) removes the text, paths and
  pixels; then save, and the file is written whole so no older revision keeps them.
- Treating `PdfAConverter.Convert` as a validator. Check `report.Succeeded`; it changes nothing when a rule cannot be met.
  Egap checks only the rules it enforces, so use a validator such as veraPDF where conformance must be proven.
- Calling `Save` after `SignAsync`. The signed bytes are the output stream; the document becomes read only
  (`IsReadOnly`), so open the signed file to go on.
- Expecting a network call. Timestamps and revocation data come only through the `HttpClient` you give
  `PdfTimestampClient` and the `Revocation` options of signing and verifying.
- Looking here for DOCX, HTML or Markdown to PDF, or PDF to DOCX: that is Egap.Documents (`SaveAsPdf`, `PdfConvert`,
  `PdfToDocument`).
- Ignoring `pdf.Warnings`. A damaged file opens repaired; the warnings say what was changed.
- Renders that differ between machines: set `PdfRenderOptions.UseSystemFonts = false` so only embedded fonts and the bundled
  substitutes draw text.
